components.name: Date picker
components.description: A popover calendar over a native date input: month and year menus, a keyboard grid (arrows, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down), min and max, disabled dates, and month names and week start from the locale. Needs monsoon.js.

options: min and max on the input
events: input and change on the native input

components.html: Sundays are closed.

components.name: Date range picker
components.description: Two date inputs in one .datepicker pick a range: the first click sets the start, the second the end, with the days between highlighted and presets such as Last 7 days. Needs monsoon.js.

options: any "Nd" preset means the last N days

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Filter as you type over a native select or an input with a datalist, following the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern. Matches are highlighted, accents are ignored and option groups are kept. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-combobox-async (ask for items with an event)

components.name: Multi select combobox
components.description: On a select with multiple the combobox shows the picks as chips. Backspace in the empty field removes the last one and the listbox stays open while you pick. Needs monsoon.js.

components.name: Select (custom)
components.description: A fully custom select over a native one, which stays in the form with its value and change events in sync. Options can carry an icon, an image, a color or a description, optgroups become headings, long lists get a search box, multiple shows chips, and it can be clearable. Keyboard and screen readers follow the WAI-ARIA select only combobox pattern, and the size, tone and variant classes of .select carry over. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-select-search (on by default from 10 options, "false" turns it off)
data-m-select-placeholder="Pick one" (or an empty first option)
data-description, data-icon, data-image or data-color on an option
select-xs to select-xl, select-primary, select-ghost and select-filled
methods: Monsoon.select(el).refresh() after changing select.value in code
events: change and input on the native select

components.name: Tags input
components.description: Chips over a plain text input that keeps a comma separated value. Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last tag, a pasted list is split, duplicates flash, and there are suggestions and a maximum. Needs monsoon.js.
components.html: Up to 6 topics. Paste a comma separated list to add many.

components.name: Sortable list
components.description: Reorder with a pointer or the keyboard: Space picks an item up, the arrows move it, Space drops it and Escape puts it back. Siblings slide out of the way and the list scrolls near its edges. Needs monsoon.js.

options: a .sortable-handle inside items limits the pointer drag to it
events: monsoon:sort { item, from, to, oldIndex, newIndex } (preventDefault undoes it)

components.name: Kanban board
components.description: Sortable lists that share a group become kanban columns: drag cards between them, or pick one up with Space and move it to the next column with the left and right arrows. Column counts update on drop. Needs monsoon.js.

options: aria-label on each list names it in announcements
events: monsoon:sort { item, from, to, oldIndex, newIndex }

components.name: Dual range slider
components.description: Two thumbs for a minimum and a maximum over two native range inputs, which keep the values for the form. Steps, a minimum gap, formatted tooltips and the WAI-ARIA slider keys. Needs monsoon.js.

options: min, max and step on the inputs
events: input and change on the native inputs

components.name: Color picker
components.description: A saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, a hex, rgb or oklch field, swatches and the eyedropper where the browser has one, over a native color input. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-color-picker-format="oklch" (hex, rgb or oklch, also what the input stores)
events: input and change on the native input

components.name: Data table
components.description: Sorting by column (numbers, money and dates sort as such), a filter box, pagination, row selection with checkboxes and Shift for ranges, a column menu and a sticky header, on top of an existing table. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-sort on a cell, data-sortable="false" on a header

components.description: Nested lists become a WAI-ARIA tree: Up and Down move, Right expands, Left collapses or goes to the parent, Home, End, type ahead and * to expand siblings. data-open starts a branch expanded. Needs monsoon.js.

components.name: Tree with checkboxes
components.description: With data-m-tree-checkbox every item gets a tristate checkbox: checking a branch checks everything below it, and a branch with some checked children shows as mixed. Space or Enter toggles. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-checked on a leaf starts it checked

components.name: Split panes
components.description: Resizable panes side by side or stacked: drag the separator, or focus it and use the arrows (Shift for bigger steps), Home, End and Enter to collapse. Minimum sizes, and sizes saved in localStorage when asked. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-splitter-min="15" (percent, or data-min on a pane)

components.name: Toast manager
components.description: Monsoon.toast("Saved", { tone: "success" }) shows a toast in a polite live region. Toasts stack per position, pause while hovered or focused, can carry an action and can be swiped away. A button can show one with data-m-toast. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-toast-position="top-center" (top or bottom, start, center or end)
methods: Monsoon.toast(message, { title, description, tone, position, duration, action: { label, onClick }, dismissible, max })

components.name: Password strength
components.description: Wires the .password-field reveal button (aria-pressed and the label follow) and scores the password from length, variety and common patterns into a four step meter with a live label. Needs monsoon.js.

components.name: Number counter
components.description: The .input-counter buttons call stepDown() and stepUp(), repeat while held, follow min, max and step, and disable at the limits. Needs monsoon.js.

options: min, max and step on the number input
events: input and change on the native input

components.name: Textarea autosize
components.description: Grows the textarea with its content. Browsers with CSS field-sizing do it natively; the script measures the others. max-height still caps it. Needs monsoon.js.

options: rows sets the starting height, max-height the limit

components.html: <textarea class="textarea max-w-md max-h-64" rows="2" data-m-autosize aria-label="Message">Write as much as you like: this box grows line by line, then scrolls once it reaches its maximum height.</textarea>

components.name: Command search
components.description: Makes a .command-palette searchable: items filter by text and data-keywords, empty headings hide, arrows move the selection, Enter runs the item, and a hotkey such as Ctrl K opens the dialog. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-command-hotkey="mod+k" (Ctrl K, or Cmd K on a Mac)
events: monsoon:command { item, value } (preventDefault keeps the palette open)

components.name: Infinite scroll
components.description: A sentinel that fires monsoon:load when it nears the viewport or a scroll container. Append the next items, then call detail.done(), or detail.done(false) at the end. Needs monsoon.js.

components.name: Countdown timer
components.description: Counts down to a date: each .countdown-value with a data-unit updates every second, the timer label for screen readers changes once a minute, and an event fires at zero. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-unit="days", "hours", "minutes" or "seconds" on each value; without days the hours keep counting
events: monsoon:tick { days, hours, minutes, seconds, total }

components.name: Paste an image
components.description: Focus the zone and paste an image with Ctrl V, or drop one: a preview appears, a file input inside receives the file for the form, and Delete clears it. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-clipboard-image-global (catch pastes anywhere on the page)
an input type="file" inside receives the image
events: monsoon:paste-image { file, url } (preventDefault skips the preview)

components.name: Rating input
components.description: A star rating with half stars, drawn as a WAI-ARIA slider over a number input that keeps the value. Hover previews, click sets, clicking the same value clears, and arrows, Home, End and digits work. Needs monsoon.js.

options: max on the input sets the number of stars, step the precision (0.5 for halves)
events: input and change on the native input

components.name: Autoplay carousel
components.description: Adds autoplay to the CSS carousel: pauses on hover, on focus, in a background tab and with reduced motion, has a play and pause button, and the current dot fills up until the next slide. Needs monsoon.js.
